planned.description: Planned — not built in this slice.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.blurb: Top bar, sidebar, mobile dock, tabs, breadcrumbs, pagination and account menus — the neutral roles stacked five ways.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.blurb: Classic, solid, soft, outline and ghost, plus icon buttons, a toolbar, and the badges and avatars that take the same pair.

forms.title: Forms
forms.blurb: Input, textarea, select, search, checkbox, radio, switch and slider — each one stacking label, value and edge at once.

cards.title: Cards
cards.blurb: Flat, toolbar, media, stat, nested, list and pricing — one per depth, for surfaces that have to stack.

lists.title: Lists & Data
lists.blurb: Plain, meta, striped, selected and bordered lists, plus a table, a definition list and a timeline.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.blurb: Alerts in all four tones, badges, progress, toasts, an undo offer and an empty state.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.blurb: Modal, drawer, dropdown, combobox, popover, command palette and banner — surfaces stacked over a scrim.

dataviz.title: Data Viz
dataviz.blurb: Bars, donut, stacked segments, lines and a heatmap per accent role — where six hues have to be told apart, not just read.

buttons.variantsDesc: One card per variant, all painted from the Trusty Button role on an identical backdrop.
buttons.sizesDesc: The same fill at three sizes, then the icon-only control in each of its three treatments.
buttons.shapesDesc: Badges and avatars take the same fill and foreground as the button — over a tenth of its area.
buttons.rolesDesc: One card per role, so a palette that only breaks on `danger` cannot hide behind six healthy buttons.
buttons.awaitingDesc: Accent roles with no 500 slot — click one to author it.
buttons.noAccents: No accent roles set yet — add one in the Design Tokens panel.

cards.depthDesc: Surface on canvas, then raised on surface. Each card sits one level deeper than the last.
cards.contextDesc: A card with a list in it, and a card with actions in it — where the divider has to separate two things that are the same colour.
cards.contentRamp: A cool neutral ramp, generated at hue 250.
cards.contentHueFifty: Nine hundred and fifty steps of the same hue.
cards.contentRaised: Raised on surface on canvas — three steps, one card.
cards.contentUpgradeBody: Unlimited palettes and a shareable token URL.
cards.contentPlaceholder: Placeholder blocks are a colour too, and the only one nobody checks.

dataviz.seriesDesc: Six roles, one step each, in a fixed order — so adjacent pairs are the ones you are asked to judge.
dataviz.scoreHint: set the accent roles to score
dataviz.readingDesc: Numbers, deltas and legends — the parts that turn a chart into a sentence someone has to trust.
dataviz.contentStacked: Stacked segments touch, so this is the strictest separation test on the page — no canvas between them.
dataviz.contentHeatmap: Same six hues at three opacities. If the faint row vanishes, the scale has no room for a tint.

feedback.onePerToneDesc: All four semantic roles at the same size, on the same canvas — so a palette that only breaks on one of them cannot hide.
feedback.scoreHint: set the four tones to score
feedback.badgesDesc: Badges carry tone at 11px with no body copy to fall back on, and the empty state is the one screen nobody ever designs.
feedback.progressDesc: A bar and a toast: the two surfaces that appear mid-task, on top of whatever the user was already reading.
feedback.toneInfoBody: Two steps fell outside the gamut.

forms.fieldsDesc: Every field stacks label, value and edge. If any two of them fail alone, they still fail here.
forms.selectionDesc: Four controls, four different answers to the same question: is the accent doing its job at this size?

lists.listsDesc: Title, meta and a trailing number — three ink levels stacked in one row, on a hairline.
lists.dataDesc: Tables, key/value blocks and a timeline — the shapes where a caption sits *under* the thing it explains.
lists.contentGapDesign: A 15px figure over a 10px caption. The gap is the whole design.

navigation.chromeDesc: The same three neutrals stacked five ways. If the steps between them are too close, this is where it shows.
navigation.identityDesc: What a nav bar carries beside its links. The accent has to hold a 30px avatar and a 9px tab label at once.
navigation.contentOnlyLastCrumb: Only the last crumb is ink. Everything behind it has to read as de-emphasised without disappearing.

overlays.scrimDesc: Content behind, scrim, panel. The panel's own edge has to separate it from what it is covering.
overlays.commandDesc: Two overlays with no scrim — they replace the page rather than sit over it, so they stack two surfaces and nothing else.
overlays.contentCrimsonRemoved: Crimson Danger and its 11 shades will be removed.
overlays.contentArrow: The arrow is filled with the panel and edged with its border, so it can never disagree with either.
overlays.contentLightCanvas: You are previewing on a light canvas.
